name: plan-harden
description: Adversarially review a design doc / spec / RFC BEFORE you build it. Runs a pre-mortem ("it's 6 months out and this failed — why?") plus parallel design-review lenses (edge cases, failure handling, data integrity, rollout/rollback, observability, scaling, security/STRIDE), then reconciles into a prioritized hardening report with an APPROVED/REVISE verdict.
